name: Intact macro + VIX-elevated arms post-selloff reversion (negative ret_Nd trigger, not momentum)
rationale: THESIS: a REVERSION (not momentum) trigger — a negative trailing return ret_Nd (recent sharp selloff, the OPPOSITE of trend-following) — armed by macro_regime still intact (gt) and vix elevated (gt a fitted stress floor). The thesis: a sharp multi-day drop INSIDE an intact macro regime with elevated-but-not-broken vol is a fear flush that reverts. ret_Nd is SIGNED and used as a reversion trigger via lt 0-ish (we BUY weakness). This is the explicit anti-momentum sibling: same dual gate, but the price trigger is a recent LOSS rather than an oversold oscillator. DISCONFIRMER 1 (reversion vs momentum): the disc-momentum-only-control / trend siblings buy ret_Nd>0; if buying ret_Nd<0 under this gate is not better, there is no reversion edge here, only momentum. DISCONFIRMER 2 (does the dual gate add over raw buy-the-dip?): ungated negative-ret control. DISCONFIRMER 3 (is vix-elevated load-bearing?): a vix-calm sibling tests whether the flush needs elevated vol. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout).
catalyst: a negative trailing ret_Nd (recent selloff) with macro intact and vix elevated
